newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says it killed 400 rebels in camp attack.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says it killed 400 rebels in camp attack.

text.p: The official Sudanese News Agency (SUNA) said on Thursday government forces killed 400 Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) rebels during an attack on their camp north of Juba.
SUNA did not say when the attack took place.
The agency said that "the armed forces managed to destroy the rebel camp northwest of Jaldo in the Terakeka province".
"The rebel forces fled from the camp leaving behind 400 killed, in addition to a number of injured," SUNA quoted a military source as saying.

The source said the attack was launched by a unified force made up of the armed forces, the tribal Mundari commandos militia and the Popular Defence Force, a volunteer force formed in 1989 to help the army fight the SPLA.
The agency quoted the source as saying that the government last week recaptured Tindalo camp, 120 kms (75 miles) northwest of Juba, from rebel forces.
The government and the SPLA have been locked in battle for 14 years. The rebels want greater autonomy or independence for the mostly Christian and animist south from the Moslem Arabised north.
